title: Archetype Template Index
description: Schema for templates/archetypes.json — machine-readable catalog of known-good, pre-verified part-archetype template scripts

name.description: Unique kebab-case identifier referenced in BUILD_PLAN.json per-part `archetype`

file.description: Template script filename, relative to templates/, e.g. enclosure_body.py

use.description: Plain-English description of what the archetype is for and when to match it

part.description: The BUILD_PLAN.json part entry the step-form template builds from: its blocks_needed instances (id, params, edges) and the interfaces whose position_mm the script places features at. The planner copies it into the plan and edits values there; the template's Part(...) id matches its id.
